$comment: SCOPE LOCK — LOCKED by Spike-0 on 2026-09-03. See docs/06-SPIKE-0-RESULTS.md for the evidence behind every value here. Frozen until every P0 acceptance criterion passes.

local_origin_utm.note: CENTRE of the bbox in UTM 43N. Chosen over the SW corner so runtime coords are symmetric (about +/-2000 m), the camera orbits the true origin, and float32 precision headroom is maximised.

study_area.clip: All geometry is clipped to the bbox. Overpass returns complete ways, which spilled up to 760 m outside the box before clipping. Buildings are kept or dropped whole by centroid (they are small, so no visible seam); ground polygons and all lines are cut at the boundary.

tiles.role: SPATIAL INDEX ONLY — not an asset-splitting scheme. Spike-0 measured ~96k triangles of ordinary buildings for the whole box, so per-tile GLBs were dropped as over-engineering. Tiles remain the lookup key for entity picking and corridor metrics.

corridors.label: Kartavya Path
corridors.no_transit_reason: A ceremonial boulevard — no bus route runs on it. Spike-0 measured 0 of 210 OSM bus route relations touching it. The bus-frequency scenario must visibly disable itself here with this reason stated, never silently return zero.

corridor_alternate.reason: 14 stops and 17 bus refs — the richest transit corridor by stop count, but fragments into 10 chains. Held as the V1.5 connector between Connaught Place and Kartavya Path.

required.note: Published monument height (42 m). OSM carries no height tag for way/361709652.
Circular colonnade. Replaces the proposed 'Sansad Bhavan', which does not exist in OSM under that name.

Rajiv Chowk Central Park plus the colonnaded inner ring around it — modelled as a ring, not one building. Rajiv Chowk Central Park is open ground, not a building. The colonnaded inner ring around it is separate building stock and is already in the buildings layer.

optional.note: The OSM footprint is the walled enclosure, not the masonry instruments inside it. Rendering it as a block would misrepresent the site.

landmarks.kind_note: kind=massing extrudes the verified footprint; kind=open renders as a flat plaza or lawn with a label and no massing. Heights resolve in order: OSM height tag (observed) -> assumed_height_m from a published dimension (estimated) -> none.

measured.note: Density is 206/km2, not the ~3000/km2 originally assumed. This is the real character of Lutyens' Delhi and it drove three scope changes — see docs/06-SPIKE-0-RESULTS.md.

height_rule.disclosure: 91.8% of buildings in this box get an estimated height. This rule is load-bearing and must be shown in the UI, not footnoted.

initial_transfer_mb.note: Target cut from 12 to 6 MB after Spike-0 measured the real geometry volume. The 15 MB PRD gate stays as the hard ceiling.

primary_benchmark_device: Apple M1, 8 GB, macOS 26.5, Chrome — integrated GPU, matches the PRD 'ordinary laptop' target
